title: Fix LLM cloud providers to respect LlmMaxResponseTokens config
description: P1 finding from 2026-07-11 audit (MSA-LLM-003): All cloud LLM providers (Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI-Compatible) hardcode MaxTokens=512 instead of reading LlmMaxResponseTokens from ChatOptions config. Admin-configured token limit is silently ignored. Source: Data/Pages/Audits/codebase-audit-20260711-10agent-swarm-5chair-council.md
